notes.title: Version 1.5.5 released
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fan achievement is impossible to receive;
	[*]Sometimes a "CHEATED" warning appears.
[/list]

notes.title: Tilesweeper is now available on Google Play!
notes.notes:
Good news!
Tilesweeper is now available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.ievo.Tilesweeper]Google Play[/url]!
Thank you for support!

notes.title: Version 1.5 released
notes.notes:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Leaderboards
    [*]Review mode after winning/losing a game
    [*]Linux / SteamOS support
    [*]MacOS: Apple Silicon support
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Optimizations
	[*]Solvable mode: added progress bar of level generation
[/list]
[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Sometimes click on a tile doesn't work
[/list]

notes.title: Tilesweeper is coming to the Xbox!
Tilesweeper is available on macOS!
notes.notes:
Good news! 
Tilesweeper is available on macOS!
Thank you for waiting and support!

notes.title: Version 1.4 released
notes.notes:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New game mode - "Solvable"
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Optimizations
	[*]Added option disable Question mark
        [*]Added option on first click always open large area
	[*]Added option remove tile pieces by timeout or automatically after fall (for slow PCs)
	
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added possibility to cleanup numbers with key 'R'
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Optimizations
    [*]Level 11. When hiding columns, it is now easier to determine where the column stood
[/list]

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*]When run a level and immediately exit, level music can overlap menu music
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added control of the camera using the keyboard
[/list]

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*]When using the joystick, when entering the pause menu, control may be lost
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]Added languages[/h1]
[list]
    [*]French
    [*]Italian
    [*]German
    [*]Spanish
    [*]Chinese (trad.)
    [*]Chinese (ex.)
    [*]Portuguese
    [*]Turkish
    [*]Japanese
[/list]

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Framerate limited by 60
[/list]

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*]In main menu, on item 15, wrong number of tiles 
    [*]Impossible to get an achievement "Fan"
[/list]

notes.title: The release date was changed to August 29, 2018.
notes.notes:
Hello.
The release date was changed to August 29, 2018.
We bring our own apologies.
